question: I bought the item 10 days ago. It is unused, I have the receipt, and it is damaged. Can I get a return?
originalResponse: The standard return policy requires an unused item, within 30 days of purchase, with a receipt. A purchase age of 10 days is within the 30-day window, and the supplied facts meet the standard return conditions; this is not a refund approval. Because the item is damaged, the case does not require human review. Please contact human support.
